title_sq: Vile Individuale me Pishine per Shitje ne Farke!

Informacion:
- Siperfaqe parcele 700 m2

Kati përdhe organizohet nga sallon i madh ndenje, kendi gatimit & kendi i ngrenies te cilat kane dalje dhe nje pamje fantastike nga ana e pishines,

title_en: Individual Villa with Pool for Sale in Farke!
description_en: Individual villas with swimming pool for sale in the Farka area, very close to Farka Lake, elite residences and TEG Shopping Center. Information: - Plot area 700 m2 - Ground floor area 225 m2 - Underground floor area 190m2 The ground floor is organized by a large living room, kitchen and dining area which have an exit and a fantastic view of the pool, we also have four bedrooms, two double rooms and two single rooms, a laundry room and three toilets. The villa is in the final stage, ready to be furnished and enjoy the peace and beauty of nature. For detailed information and a visit to the property, contact us.
